channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Tamil Nadu is with NDA!' PM Modi says ahead of rally in Madurantakam
item.description: BJP state president Nainar Nagenthran said the event would kick off the alliance's electoral battle and send a strong message against the DMK-led government.

item.title: Trump says Putin, Zelensky want deal, cites complex war
item.description: The president highlighted the harsh humanitarian situation in Ukraine, particularly during winter, and said conditions were extremely difficult for civilians. He also touched on other foreign policy issues, including Greenland, Venezuela, Iran and US military strength, while reiterating his preference to avoid conflict despite deploying significant military assets.

item.title: Vishal Jethwa reacts to Homebound's exit from Oscars 2026, says, "there were expectations"
item.description: Neeraj Ghaywan's 'Homebound' starring Vishal Jethwa, Ishaan Khatter and Janhvi Kapoor has not been able to make it to the final nomination in the Best International Feature Film category for the upcoming 98th Academy Awards (Oscars 2026).

item.title: Freight train reaches Anantnag: 42-wagon rice rake boosts Kashmir food supply
item.description: Indian Railways has achieved a major logistics milestone as the first full-length freight train carrying rice reached Anantnag Goods Terminal in south Kashmir within 24 hours of departure. The 42-BCN wagon rake operated in coordination with the Food Corporation of India.

item.title: "Broken, completely done": Bhumi Pednekar took 6-month break amid 'The Royals' backlash
item.description: Bhumi Pednekar reveals she was left numb with the trolling and the backlash that came her way post 'The Royals', forced her to take a 6- month long break to come out of the bubble.

item.title: Janhvi Kapoor's Homebound out of Oscars 2026 race, fans say 'epic PR fail, wasn't Oscars worthy'
item.description: Karan Johar's Homebound has not secured a nomination in the Best International Feature Film category for the upcoming 98th Academy Awards. Films nominated in the category are The Secret Agent, It Was Just An accident, Sentimental Value, Sirat and The Voice Of Hind Rajab. The awards will take place on 15 March at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, LA.

item.title: Disha Patani gives sultry twist to saree; flaunts midriff; BFF Mouni Roy drops flirty comment; fans say 'Tiger Shroff lost diamond'
item.description: Disha Patani once again grabbed attention with her bold saree look, draped in her signature sultry style. While netizens had mixed reactions to her unconventional draping, many praised her fashion choices. However, it was her bestie actor Mouni Roy's comment that wowed fans.

item.title: Road deaths continue unabated in J&K: 3,688 killed in last 3.5 years, most accidents occur between 3-9PM
item.description: At least 3,688 people have lost their lives in more than 20,000 road accidents in Jammu and Kashmir over the last three and a half years, with most crashes occurring between 3 pm and 9 pm due to rash driving and speeding.

item.title: Border 2 morning shows cancelled due to technical glitch; Sunny Deol says 'No stress, no worries'
item.description: Sunny Deol's Border 2, released today, faced last-minute technical issues, delaying its 7.30 and 8 am screenings across India. The final version wasn't ready until late Thursday, but shows are now running smoothly.

item.title: PM Modi flags off new trains, launches credit scheme, lays foundation stones for key projects in Kerala
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Kerala on Friday, inaugurating and launching multiple infrastructure, transport, social welfare, and scientific initiatives. At Puthirikandom Maidan, he flagged off four new train services, including three Amrit Bharat Express trains and a Thrissur-Guruvayur passenger train, enhancing connectivity across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
